data.one_liner: CLI tool to scaffold Flutter Clean Architecture projects with BLoC, GetX, or Riverpod.
data.what_it_does: ARLCLE is a CLI platform that scaffolds Clean Architecture project structures for Flutter, integrates state management (BLoC, GetX, or Riverpod), configures networking (Dio or Http), and adds AI agent support.
use_when: Starting a new Flutter project and wanting a standardized Clean Architecture structure
Integrating AI coding assistant rules and workflows (Claude, Codex, Gemini) into a project
Generating feature modules and managing localization or CI/CD pipelines via CLI
avoid_when: Working within an existing, non-standard project structure where you do not want to adopt Clean Architecture
Looking for a runtime library rather than a development and scaffolding CLI tool
strengths: Quickly bootstraps scalable Clean Architecture folder structures
Supports multiple state management choices (BLoC, GetX, Riverpod) and networking clients
Provides built-in AI agent context setup and pre-commit quality checks
weaknesses: Opinionated structure that may require conforming to specific architectural patterns
External CLI tool dependencies and requirements for global pub cache configuration
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `dart pub global activate arcle` and ensure the pub cache bin folder is in your system PATH.
